observations.evidence: G02/G03/G04 referenced; Moon as recipient; planet-to-life-to-Earth mediation; multiple recipients.
Incoming pulses, attached organic-life boundary, differentiated outputs, recipient response.
Only Gurdjieff scene implemented; no cross-tradition renderer demonstration.

risks: Particles can misleadingly imply transported material where source says influence.
Moon-brightness cue could imply literal rapid growth rather than dependence.
Colors and pulse shapes are locally differentiated; no universal mapping has been demonstrated.
Captions make the argument clear but mask possible weaknesses in independent visual decoding.
decisions: Do not promote a visual primitive on the basis of one attractive animation.
Do not claim the film was generated entirely from the ontology.
next_test: Captionless recognition of reception vs transfer vs dependence; compare a static baseline; repeat on a non-material cosmological claim.
